title: Seat and Bag Subscription Status Credit in Summit Requalification
content:
A member's seat and bag subscription under the Crestline Seat and Bag Subscriptions charter earns a status credit in the counted qualifying dollars on which the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program sets the tier of the calendar year. The subscription's product and status are read from its record.

| Subscription product on record | Status | Status credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Domestic | Active | 400 |
| Crestline Seat and Bag Pass Network | Active | 400 |
| Crestline Bag Pass One | Active | 200 |
| Crestline Bag Pass Two | Active | 200 |
| Crestline Seat Pass Domestic | Active | 200 |
| Crestline Seat Pass Network | Active | 200 |

A member with no active subscription adds no status credit.

**Points of judgement**

- The product alone is not enough; the subscription must be active.
- The combined seat-and-bag products carry 400 USD; the single bag or single seat products carry 200 USD.
- Hypothetical case: a member whose Crestline Bag Pass Two is active adds 200 USD; if the same pass is no longer active, nothing is added.
